scope: Completed motivation-relevant EHR-ChatQA experiments through 2026-09-14; no experiment reruns or rescoring.

authoritative_motivations.motivation_1: With metadata available, compare Original versus Star and Full Tools versus SQL-only in performance and in Original-only versus Star-only table/column identifier use on Star trajectories.
authoritative_motivations.motivation_2: Within Motivation 1's SQL-only condition, compare Metadata Available versus Unavailable.
authoritative_motivations.motivation_3: Repeat Motivation 1 across known-size model families without assuming a required directional trend.

motivation_1.star_direction: Neither Full nor SQL Available shows a universal Original-to-Star penalty or benefit.
motivation_1.verdict: Performance benefit is conditional, but Full Tools' reduction of Original-only identifier reuse on Star is highly consistent.

motivation_2.estimand: Metadata is the combined treatment: allowed plus benchmark guidance versus blocked plus identifier-free guidance.
motivation_2.verdict: This is the strongest and most replicated motivation result.

motivation_3.verdict: Known-size family replication is complete descriptively, but no universal size trend is supported.

supporting_cohorts.cohort: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite official-user Full Tools IncreQA
supporting_cohorts.coverage: M1 Full arm plus scope-aware naming

supporting_cohorts.cohort: Gemini 3.8 Flash official-user SQL-only A/B IncreQA
supporting_cohorts.coverage: M2 complete; M1 SQL arm only

supporting_cohorts.coverage: Historical M1 SQL arm and M2

excluded_or_superseded: Ministral pilot slots reused inside subset80 are not additional replication.
Older Gemini 3.8 expanded A/B is superseded by the official-user A/B rerun.
Older Flash-Lite Full runs are mixed-source and superseded by official-user reruns.
Gemini CDEF stopped at 43/256 and cannot fill the missing Full control.
SQL_VALUE/value-similarity studies do not count as six-tool Full Tools.
Reasoning variants, endpoint smokes and canceled partial runs are compatibility evidence, not headline cohorts.
remaining_gaps: Run Gemini 3.8 Flash Full Tools Available on the same 32-task A/B subset to complete M1 for the main backbone.
Extend Qwen3.5 MoE to the shared 80-task subset for matched cross-family coverage.
Add repeated trials to estimate per-task reliability; current primary cohorts are k=1.
Only if a narrower mechanism is needed, separate catalog access from identifier-bearing guidance and decompose the Full Tools bundle.

overall_assessment.one_sentence: The evidence strongly supports schema-information dependence and tool-assisted schema adaptation, while showing that renaming and model-size effects are conditional rather than universally directional.
